title: Maybe we should have called it a day. | Quiet Backyard Living
storyTitle: Maybe we should have called it a day.
description: The walls were moving forward. The last piece of paneling had other ideas.
noteHtml:
I made a bad measurement and ruined a piece of paneling, so we decided to call it quits for the day.

Another ruined piece of paneling.

Looking back, maybe we should have used that last day, which was cooler and really beautiful, to just relax and enjoy what we had already accomplished.
